text:
emma: FinReg asked for a concise access-control bundle for their SIG review: SAML->RBAC mapping, a service-account rotation note, session TTLs, a one-row MFA audit proof, and a concrete example of token scoping. Need by EOD.

tony: I can pull the SAML and MFA pieces. Quick summary: we accept SAML 2.0/OIDC. MFA is recorded via the 'amr' claim (e.g., amr: ["sms","otp"]) or an explicit mfa=true audit field. For Hosted tenants we recommend IdP-enforced MFA; we also allow tenant-level enforcement for sensitive roles.

rachel: I'll do RBAC + service account notes. For this pack I'll show a JSON export example (they asked for different formats). Service accounts issue short-lived JWTs by default (3600s) and are scoped to API prefixes. For Private deployments we offer HSM-backed keys; for Hosted we use KMS with monthly rotation for root keys and automated weekly rotation for signing keys. Compromise path: immediate revoke + audit and key reissue.

emma: Can we show a sample SAML AttributeStatement and a token-scope example? Also need the curl to pull the MFA audit row.

tony: Sample SAML AttributeStatement (compact):

<AttributeStatement>
  <Attribute Name="email"><AttributeValue>${user.email}</AttributeValue></Attribute>
  <Attribute Name="groups"><AttributeValue>${user.groups}</AttributeValue></Attribute>
  <Attribute Name="entitlements"><AttributeValue>redwood:runtime-deployer</AttributeValue></Attribute>
</AttributeStatement>

tony: Token scoping example (JWT claims we emit for service accounts):

{"iss":"https://auth.redwood","sub":"svc:poc-runner","scope":"models.read","exp":1699999999,"aud":"https://api.redwood"}

rachel: RBAC JSON snippet we plan to include: 

{"roles":[{"id":"observer","perms":["models:read","logs:read"]},{"id":"deployer","perms":["deployments:create","deployments:update"]}],"service_accounts":[{"id":"poc-sa","scopes":["models.read"],"token_ttl_seconds":3600,"allowed_prefix":"/v1/models/poc-"}]}

emma: curl to fetch a single MFA-auth row (org-admin token required):

curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" "https://console.redwood/api/v1/audit?filter=event:authentication.success AND (mfa:true OR amr:*otp*)&limit=1"

infra-bot: export created: /exports/finreg/mfa_proof_1912345678.csv (presigned link, expires in 48h)

rachel: Short rotation blurb for SIG answer: "Service account credentials are issued as short-lived JWTs or mTLS certs. Signing keys are stored in KMS (Hosted) or HSM (Private) and rotated automatically (signing keys weekly, root keys monthly). On suspected compromise we revoke tokens and keys immediately via the revocation API and re-issue with audit-tracked events."

ella: Session defaults we can paste: console idle timeout = 45m (customer-configurable), interactive session = 60m, API access token TTL = 900s (refresh_token supported). Breakglass: two-approver workflow, time-limited creds, and elevated audit markers.

emma: Great — rachel, tony: please assemble the ZIP with SAML XML, RBAC JSON, the infra-bot CSV link, and a short one-paragraph SIG paste-ready answer. Upload link into thread when ready.

rachel: will do, dropping the ZIP shortly.
